panels.title: Top products by revenue
panels.description: Best sellers by KES over the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS product, sum(oi.total)::float8 AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PROCESSING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED') AND o.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top products by units sold
panels.description: Quantity sold, so premium-priced but low-volume products don't hide.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS product, sum(oi.quantity)::float8 AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PROCESSING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED') AND o.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Payments by provider over time
panels.description: M-Pesa vs Stripe completions scraped from the API.

panels.title: Average rating
panels.description: Approved reviews only, across the whole catalogue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(round(avg(rating)::numeric, 2), 0) AS avg_rating FROM reviews WHERE status = 'APPROVED'

panels.title: Average rating by category
panels.description: Mean star rating of approved reviews per category.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS category, round(avg(r.rating)::numeric, 2) AS average_rating, count(r.id) AS reviews FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Correlated: rating × revenue per category
panels.description: CORRELATED METRIC — rating alone or revenue alone never tells this story: whether higher-rated products actually sell more.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS category, sum(oi.total)::float8 AS revenue, round(coalesce(avg(r.rating), 0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.status = 'APPROVED' WHERE o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PROCESSING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED') AND o.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY c.name HAVING sum(oi.total) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Low-stock watchlist
panels.description: Anything below ten units needs a restock decision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, sku, stock, is_active FROM products WHERE stock < 10 ORDER BY stock ASC, name LIMIT 20
